name: Bhimarn Prathom Residence and Connected Royal Halls
scope: Four physically linked halls in present-day Sanam Chandra Palace: Bhimarn Prathom with its western-style garden façade, the southern Aphirom Ruedi wing, gilded Vajariromaya Hall with a Thai layered roof, and the northern raised Samakkhi Mukhamat audience hall. Includes the connecting upper-floor galleries and the open central light court.

originalReview.notes: The creator’s corrected description identifies Vajariromaya. The view covers the south portico, the stair and double storey, orange-and-dark-blue roof tiers, gilded roof finials and pointed gold doorhoods. A low Thai roof leads north toward the audience hall.

originalReview.notes: East garden front of Bhimarn Prathom. Cream masonry, low blue-grey roofs, a projecting half-timber gable, a three-bay scalloped entrance balcony and painted blue-green timber lace on the open gallery to the north.
